items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: This must have been around about the time you were playing with Arnold De Pass. Yes.

ctx.x: Forest. Club Forest. That's where Loi was playing. The Club was a fall band. This band wasn't my regular band. I don't know. I was still playing with my the party. I was in the Eureka band. Some of the bands had to die.
This must have been around about the time you were playing with Arnold De Pass. Yes.
I don't know if it was a year the other ones. I don't know if it was a change to take.
